metadata.key_test: Highest-P1 case absorbs extreme complexity (fusion) non-violently; Safeguard F triggered (AfD >25% + regional divergence ~30%) yet no collapse; Mod10 backstop (federalism + Basic Law eternity clause).
metadata.notes: Run4 Case 15. WGI cited on World Bank estimate scale (-2.5 to +2.5). Existing-dataset P1=0.890 used as given for ordinal placement (highest of the five). Most pillar values ordinal/estimated, not cardinal.

pre_event.event_description: Reunification: West Germany absorbs ~16 million people from the radically different East German institutional system -- fusion / complexity expansion.

context.backstop_details: Mod10 backstop: federalism + the Basic Law's eternity clause (Art. 79(3)) + federal-intervention powers.

Germany.notes: Highest P1 of the five (existing dataset P1=0.890; WGI RoL ~1.53, GE ~1.19, estimate scale). regional_antisystem_vote recorded as the peak AfD 2024 state result (Thuringia 32.8%); also Saxony 30.6% (behind CDU 31.9%) and ~29% Brandenburg -- all well above the 25% Safeguard F threshold. Regional divergence near/above 30% (eastern GDP/cap ~66-72% of West; eastern productivity ~80% of western).

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Highest P1 -> best outcome: high capacity absorbs extreme complexity; non-violent, democratic stress expression and higher absolute convergence.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Government collapse, secession, or political violence.

b_violence.prediction: No political violence; strain channelled through democratic politics.

c_convergence.prediction: Persistent East-West configuration mismatch (convergence stalls), expressed non-violently.
c_convergence.basis: Eastern GDP/cap ~66-72% of West, barely moved since ~2000; productivity ~80%.
c_convergence.falsification_condition: Full East-West convergence, or mismatch turning violent.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Configuration mismatch (regional / East-West economic), expressed via the AfD's rise rather than institutional failure.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure driven by an institutional (P1) collapse.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: N/A -- not a democratic-transition reversal case.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Safeguard F triggered (AfD >25% in eastern states + regional divergence ~30%), yet no government collapse, no secession, no political violence; Mod10 backstop = federalism + Basic Law eternity clause.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: Safeguard F triggers translate into collapse/secession/violence.

analysis.overall_assessment: Thesis confirmed: the highest-P1 case absorbed extreme fusion complexity non-violently. Real, persistent East-West strain channelled through democratic politics; no collapse, secession, or violence.
safeguards_triggered: F (AfD >25% in eastern states + regional divergence ~30%)
I (porosity-with-backstop, Mod10: federalism + Basic Law eternity clause Art. 79(3))
